highlights: AI biotech Formation Bio is betting the real bottleneck is clinical trials. With a new $600 million fund to buy or license potential drugs that have stalled out, the startup now hopes to prove that it’s right. Formation Bio cofounder and CEO Ben Liu has a theory about AI and drugs. Liu has now raised a $600 million investment fund to prove out that thesis. “There are increasingly more good discovered drugs, and the fundamental bottleneck is how do you show they work in the clinic,” Liu tells Forbes. With the new fund, he hopes to acquire or license 10 to 15 new drugs over the next three to five years, and push them through clinical trials faster with the help of AI. “Our thesis is that you are going to have a logjam of beautifully designed drugs, and you’re not going to know if they work for diseases until they go through the trials,” he says.
